title: Senior Product Manager, Cloud
description:
As a Senior Product Manager on the Cloud team at ClickHouse, you will be responsible for leading the development and delivery of Cloud-focused features for our flagship offering. Potential areas of focus include the ClickHouse Cloud query experience, data visualization, and Cloud-native enhancements to the core product.

You will work closely with the design and engineering teams to ensure that each feature contributes to an intuitive, cohesive product experience, and is built to meet the needs of our customers. You will also collaborate with the marketing and sales teams to ensure that the product is effectively positioned and promoted in the market.

THE ROLE:

Feature Ideation, Definition, and Development

- Define and drive development of existing initiatives comprising the product roadmap for ClickHouse Cloud.

- Be responsible for ensuring that these initiatives are delivered such that they align with our company goals and meet customer needs.

- Conduct market research and gather customer feedback to inform priorities, and help manage the product backlog to ensure that the most valuable features and enhancements are prioritized and delivered in a timely manner. Prioritization is key.

- Feel strongly about a feature that hasn’t yet been considered? No problem. This role benefits from high degrees of both autonomy and impact-you will be empowered to ideate and propose net-new initiatives, thereby contributing directly to our overall product strategy and direction.

Cross-functional Leadership and Collaboration

- Every project requires collaboration between various teams at ClickHouse and you are the glue that holds them together. You will be responsible for coordinating with partners on the design, engineering, and security teams to ensure that they are aligned on scope and timeline for each project. You will also be principally in-charge of identifying, communicating, and resolving cross-team blockers and dependencies.

- You will be the internal ‘face’ of your projects.

- Pre-shipment, you will deliver periodic status updates to our leadership team and the broader company. You will also collaborate with our marketing and sales teams to develop and execute on feature launch strategy (documentation, positioning, messaging, pricing). Finally, you will conduct pre-launch enablement sessions for our sales and support teams, such that they are equipped to convey this information to our customers.

- Post-shipment, you will maintain internal and external documentation and help our sales and support teams address customer questions, concerns, and feedback.

Performance Monitoring and Incremental Improvement

- You will define, track, and own key performance indicators (KPIs) for your projects and regularly report on progress to stakeholders.

- We ship incremental improvements across our product surface area every single week. You will obsessively monitor and analyze product usage and performance data to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

- Relatedly, a crucial underpinning of any successful product is polish-nobody likes papercuts. You will dog-food our product on a daily basis and suggest incremental improvements that reduce jagged edges and contribute to a polished product experience.

YOU BRING:

- 3+ years of cloud software engineering or related technical experience

- Experience working with SQL databases and data analytics (prior experience with ClickHouse preferred but not required)

- Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality products to market.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to use data to inform product decisions.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

- Strong leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate others to achieve goals.

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare -

title: Product Manager
description:
About GaggleAMP
GaggleAMP helps companies turn employees into active advocates on social media. Our customers run employee advocacy programs that drive brand visibility, sales engagement, and recruiting impact, all with minimal effort from the people involved. We've been at this for years, have real customers, and have a clear point of view about what we do and who we do it for.
Mission
Own product at GaggleAMP so that every feature we ship makes our customers' jobs genuinely easier and proves measurable value to their organizations, applying phase-one discipline and customer evidence to every decision.
Outcomes
We share this scorecard openly so you know exactly what success looks like.
By day 30:

• Reviewed at least 20 recorded customer calls and built working knowledge of customer pains and language patterns

• Held one-on-ones with each developer, the engineering lead, the customer success lead, the CEO, and at least two CS team members

• Read and internalized our product principles, persona docs, brand guide, and GTM playbook well enough to apply them in conversation

• Audited the current product backlog, can articulate what's in flight and why, and formed initial opinions on prioritization

• Scoped at least two product optimizations end-to-end (from usage data through a defined solution to engineering handoff)

• Produced a written first-impressions document for the CEO and engineering lead

By day 90:

• Shipped at least one meaningful piece of new work that you scoped, designed, and handed off, with engineering buy-in

• Own and run weekly product/design reviews independently

• Produced a roadmap proposal for the upcoming quarter, defined as the full mix of new capability, optimizations to existing flows, and infrastructure work that affects usability. Grounded in customer evidence and our product principles

• Built your own customer conversation cadence (at least two live customer calls per month)

• Reduced senior leadership involvement in feature-level product decisions to near zero

• Made at least one clearly defensible "no" to a feature request, based on principle application rather than capacity

Competencies
Customer obsession and persona discipline. Every product decision grounded in real customer evidence, applied to a specific persona, not imagined users.
Phase-one scoping discipline. Ship the smallest meaningful version first and let customer feedback drive what comes next. Comfortable cutting scope. Can defend "no" with reasoning.
Strategic and tactical balance. Real product work is a mix of new capability, optimizations, and usability-affecting infrastructure, not just new feature delivery. Resist the bias toward shipping new things at the expense of improving what exists.
AI-leveraged execution with human ownership. Use AI tools fluently across discovery, writing, design, and analysis. Own every outcome and deliverable as your own work, regardless of which tools helped produce it. AI is leverage, not a substitute for judgment.
Scrappy execution and self-direction. Operate without scaffolding. Build your own systems and rhythms. Comfortable with ambiguity. Direct in communication, including with leadership.
Design fluency (a plus, not required). Comfortable partnering on UI work and reviewing it against our design system. Hands-on Figma execution is a bonus.
How we work
Small team, fast cadence, customer-driven. You'll partner closely with engineering on a continuous shipping rhythm and have direct CEO engagement on product strategy. You'll own product end-to-end: there's no separate designer, no PM peer, no analyst pulling reports for you. We use AI tools heavily and expect you to.
This role is for builders, not process managers. If you want to talk to customers, make the strategic calls, influence the design of the screens, write the stories, and ship to real people who depend on the product, let's talk.

title: NetSuite Implementation Lead
description:
ERP Implementation Lead

Remote / Field-Based | Travel Required

Robbins Recruiting Solutions is partnering with a rapidly growing, private equity-backed organization in the fire and life safety services industry to identify an ERP Implementation Lead. This is a highly visible, hands-on role responsible for leading the deployment and adoption of NetSuite across a growing network of operating companies.

This individual will serve as the internal functional NetSuite expert and implementation leader, partnering closely with finance, accounting, operations, branch leadership, and an external implementation partner. The role will own deployments from initial discovery through go-live and stabilization, helping standardize processes while ensuring solutions work effectively within entrepreneurial, field-based businesses. Aspyre - ERP Implementation Lea…

What You’ll Do

• Lead end-to-end NetSuite implementations across multiple operating companies, from requirements gathering through go-live and post-launch support.

• Develop implementation plans, timelines, milestones, readiness criteria, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Partner with finance, accounting, operations, and branch leadership to understand current processes and design practical future-state workflows.

• Serve as the primary functional liaison with the external NetSuite implementation partner.

• Provide functional guidance around workflows, approval hierarchies, user roles, dashboards, reporting, and core transaction processes.

• Coordinate data mapping, cleansing, migration, validation, and reconciliation.

• Lead user acceptance testing and ensure system configuration, integrations, permissions, and reporting meet business requirements.

• Develop cutover and go-live plans that minimize disruption to the business.

• Create training materials and provide hands-on training for accounting, administrative, operational, and field-based users.

• Provide on-site support during go-live and stabilization, helping troubleshoot issues and drive user adoption.

• Identify opportunities to improve reporting, controls, workflow efficiency, scalability, and the overall user experience. Aspyre - ERP Implementation Lea…

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate brings approximately 5+ years of experience supporting ERP implementations, enterprise system deployments, or finance-process transformation initiatives, with meaningful hands-on NetSuite experience.

Candidates should have experience across multiple stages of the ERP implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, process design, configuration, data migration, testing, training, cutover, and post-launch support.

Strong knowledge of core financial and operational processes-including procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, general ledger, AP/AR, approval workflows, and financial reporting-is important for success in this role. Aspyre - ERP Implementation Lea…

Experience implementing or standardizing systems across multiple entities, branches, locations, or acquired businesses is highly valued. Experience within a private equity-backed, acquisition-driven, multi-location, or field-services organization is strongly preferred. Aspyre - ERP Implementation Lea…

The Right Fit

You’ll thrive in this opportunity if you are hands-on, highly organized, comfortable working independently, and enjoy being the person who connects business needs with technology. You should be equally comfortable working with executives, accounting teams, implementation partners, and field-based employees-and able to translate complex system concepts into practical solutions.

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in building the infrastructure of a growing organization while helping newly acquired businesses successfully transition onto a standardized NetSuite platform.

Location: Remote / Field-Based

Travel: Regular travel to operating companies during implementation, go-live, and stabilization periods.

title: Principal Engineer, Team Lead- Motion Planning
description:
Tech Lead Manager, Planning
On our Planning team, you'll apply your passion in robotics and software development for production-ready autonomous vehicles. As the Technical Lead Manager, you will direct a team tasked with the design and implementation of motion planning software for autonomous vehicles. This position requires leadership in defining the motion planning and control systems that enable our fleet to operate securely, effectively, and with passenger comfort in intricate settings. As a leader, you will drive the development of cutting-edge motion planning algorithms, collaborate with cross-functional teams (Localization, Perception, Prediction, Controls, ML Products, and Systems Engineering), and mentor a talented group of engineers to deliver state-of-the-art solutions. If you are passionate about autonomous driving, thrive on solving challenging real-world problems, and are eager to make a significant impact in a rapidly evolving field, we want to hear from you.
Role responsibilities:

• Lead and develop a team within the motion planning organization, assuming responsibility for planning algorithm and constraint generation.

• Collaborate with other leaders to provide technical direction, making critical decisions on architectural strategies, strategic resource allocation, operational execution, and technical debt management.

• Deliver a robust and scalable planner, prioritizing safety throughout the design, prototyping, testing, deployment, and production phases.

• Adopt a metrics-driven approach to the development and enhancement of technical components.

• Advance existing planning methodologies to facilitate data-driven strategies.

• Promote diversity and inclusion in both products and personnel.

• Mentor and offer constructive feedback (technical and professional) to team members, cultivating an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

• Demonstrate initiative in generating innovative ideas, formulating a team vision, and considering the holistic robotaxi system.

• Implement and review algorithms and code, applying rigorous engineering methodologies.

• Partner with project managers to develop roadmaps and execute plans according to schedule.

What we're looking for:

• Over two years of experience in the management of a development team, with a demonstrated ability to foster career growth, mentor team members effectively, and enhance productivity.

• Masters or PhD in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

• Established history of successfully delivering production-quality motion planner in a leadership capacity.

• Advanced proficiency in search algorithms.

• Experience in developing motion planning solutions with ML

• Expertise in C++ software development, Linux, and Python, with supplementary knowledge of SQL.

• Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience in motion planning under conditions of uncertainty, as well as in interactions with dynamic agents and environments.

• Knowledge of robotics algorithms in localization, perception, prediction, motion planning, and control systems for autonomous vehicles.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and management skills.

Skills appreciated

• Experience in Autonomous Vehicles or other robotics industries

• Experience using simulation tools

• Experience with Verification & Validation for safety critical systems

description:

title: Inventory Processing Specialist
description:
Inventory Processing Specialist - Quality Control
Founded in 2017, REPS & Co. has rapidly become a leader in data analytics in the entertainment industry. Recognized on the Forbes list of America's Best Startup Employers, we focus on delivering advanced analytics that supports data driven decisions. Our solutions provide comprehensive insights and forecasts, enabling us to have a better understanding and response to supply and demand in the ticketing world. With a commitment to driving innovation, REPS & Co. helps shape a dynamic market environment.
We’re excited to add an Inventory Processing Specialist to our Quality Control team.
In this role, you’ll help ensure our ticket inventory is accurate, valid, and ready for sale. You’ll review purchases and listings, verify important ticket details, identify and correct discrepancies, and work closely with internal teams to maintain accurate inventory.
This position is ideal for someone who isdetail-oriented, comfortable with technology, quick to learn new systems, and able to work accurately in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do

• Learn and become proficient in company-specific processes, software, and systems.

• Review and approve inventory to ensure tickets are accurate and cleared for sale.

• Audit ticket purchases for accuracy and resolve discrepancies.

• Attach ticket PDFs and supporting documentation to listings in our POS system.

• Add required disclosures and restrictions to ticket listings so customers receive accurate information.

• Collaborate with internal brokers and team members to verify ticket purchases and inventory details.

• Research, track, and document orders that were not entered into the POS system and accurately enter missing orders.

• Track and process refund-related information.

• Purchase tickets as needed, representing up to approximately 10% of the role.

• Assist with additional Quality Control and inventory-related responsibilities as needed.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

• Comfortable working with technology and able to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes.

• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets.

• Fast and accurate data-entry skills; previous data-entry experience is a plus.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Dependable, punctual, and able to consistently meet responsibilities and deadlines.

• Collaborative team player who communicates constructively, listens actively, and willingly shares information.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt to changing priorities, demands, and timelines.

• Self-motivated and proactive, with the initiative to identify and complete tasks without constant direction.

• Willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities as business needs evolve.

• Ability and willingness to work rotating shifts as required.

What Success Looks Like
You’ll be successful in this role if you consistently maintain accurate inventory, catch discrepancies before they affect customers, learn new processes quickly, and communicate effectively with your team. You’ll play an important part in making sure customers receive accurate ticket information and that our inventory is ready for sale.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: Minimum 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time
Employment Type: Long-Term Contract
About the Role
We’re looking for a senior Full-Stack Developer to build and evolve Sergio , an AI assistant designed for home service businesses, starting with cleaning companies. You’ll own features across the frontend, backend, data, billing, integrations, and AI capabilities while working closely with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor.
This role is ideal for someone who can move quickly, make sound technical decisions independently, and consistently ship polished, production-ready work.
Key Responsibilities
Product Development

• Build and iterate on Sergio using Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

• Develop responsive, production-ready features and screens deployed through Vercel.

• Turn product requirements and rough mockups into polished user experiences.

Backend & Data Architecture

• Design and maintain multi-tenant data structures using Supabase and PostgreSQL.

• Implement and maintain Row-Level Security (RLS) to properly isolate customer data.

• Manage authentication flows and backend data architecture.

Billing & Integrations

• Own the Stripe billing integration, including subscriptions, webhooks, plan management, and edge cases.

• Build and maintain reliable SMS and email delivery pipelines.

• Develop and maintain third-party integrations as the product evolves.

AI & LLM Development

• Build AI-powered product features using the Anthropic API or comparable LLM APIs.

• Work hands-on with prompt design, response handling, and LLM integration.

• Ensure AI-generated outputs are useful, reliable, and naturally integrated into the product experience.

UI/UX & Frontend Quality

• Build polished, responsive interfaces from rough mockups without requiring constant designer involvement.

• Apply strong UX/UI judgment across components and user flows.

• Maintain a high standard of usability and visual quality.

AI-Assisted Development

• Work daily with AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor.

• Review AI-generated code critically and identify errors, security issues, and architectural problems.

• Guide AI tools toward production-quality implementations rather than relying on them blindly.

Testing & Delivery

• Write Playwright or comparable end-to-end tests for critical product flows.

• Ship small, focused changes to the development branch consistently.

• Communicate progress, decisions, blockers, and technical reasoning clearly through async written updates.

Required Experience & Skills

• Senior-level experience building and shipping full-stack web applications in production.

• Strong hands-on expertise with Next.js App Router and TypeScript .

• Experience with Supabase or another PostgreSQL-backed platform .

• Strong understanding of multi-tenant data modeling and Row-Level Security .

• Experience integrating Stripe subscription billing , including webhooks and edge cases.

• Hands-on experience using LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, or equivalent in a real product.

• Experience with Playwright or comparable end-to-end testing frameworks .

title: Software Engineering Manager, Database (SmithDB)
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the team

SmithDB is LangChain's internal database team. We're building a storage and query layer purpose-built for AI observability and evaluation. Within six months we went from idea to a production system that offers industry leading performance and scalability for agent observability data. We're a small, fast team of systems engineers tackling genuinely hard problems: storage layout, query execution, compaction, and scaling toward trillions of agent traces. We develop in Rust, run on Kubernetes, and integrate tightly with S3/GCS/Azure Blob. There are no legacy constraints; this is a greenfield system with real production load and ambitious engineering goals.

 

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead the SmithDB team. This is not a pure people-management role. You'll write production code, review PRs at the systems level, make architectural calls, and be in the weeds alongside your engineers. At the same time, you'll own team health, hiring, technical roadmap, and coordination with the broader LangSmith platform. The ideal candidate has deep systems or database engineering experience and genuinely prefers to stay technical while growing a team.

 

What you'll do

- Write and review production Rust code across ingestion, query execution, and storage layers

- Lead architectural decisions on storage format, compaction, indexing, and query planning

- Drive performance investigations using memory and CPU profiling tools; own the path from profiling to shipped fix

- Design and harden the distributed deployment of SmithDB services on Kubernetes (multi-tenant, high-throughput, low-latency)

- Contribute to cloud object store integrations (S3, GCS, Azure Blob) and set the standard for how SmithDB manages data at rest and in flight

- Build and maintain observability for the engine itself: metrics, tracing, debug tooling

- Manage a small but growing team of systems engineers: set goals, run 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and grow careers

- Own the SmithDB technical roadmap in partnership with LangSmith product and engineering leadership

- Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to the broader organization: you write concise, decision-ready updates

 

What you'll bring

- 7+ years in systems or database engineering, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or engineering management role

- Production Rust experience - you can write it, review it, and have opinions on how to structure it at scale

- Deep understanding of database or storage engine internals: query execution, storage layouts, indexing, compaction

- Proficiency in systems performance analysis: memory allocators

title: Power Controls Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is seeking an experienced Power Controls Engineer to develop and implement advanced control algorithms for high-performance power electronic systems. We're looking for someone with deep expertise in control system modeling and simulation - particularly in Simulink and PLECS - who can take a controls concept from simulation through hardware validation. This individual will own the control architecture for DC/DC converters, inverters, and motor drives built around discrete SiC and GaN power stages, and will work closely with power hardware and firmware engineers to deliver tightly integrated, high-reliability systems for defense and aerospace applications.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Design, simulate, and validate closed-loop control algorithms for switch-mode power converters and inverters using Simulink and/or PLECS.

• Controls for 3-phase AC systems, with and without a switched Neutral

• Develop plant models and controller architectures (voltage-mode, current-mode, sensorless FOC, etc.) for multi-kW power stages utilizing discrete SiC and GaN FETs.

• Perform stability analysis, loop shaping, and compensator design to meet transient response, efficiency, and EMI targets.

• Collaborate with power hardware engineers on gate drive tuning, dead-time optimization, and switching-loss characterization of wide-bandgap devices.

• Support model-based code generation workflows and work with firmware engineers to translate control designs into embedded implementations.

• Define and execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and power-hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) test plans to validate control performance against system requirements.

• Contribute to trade studies on converter topology, modulation strategy, and control bandwidth as they relate to size, weight, power, and thermal constraints.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience designing and tuning digital control loops for power electronic converters (DC/DC, DC/AC, or motor drives).

• Proficiency in Simulink and/or PLECS for control system modeling, simulation, and analysis.

• Strong foundation in control theory - z-domain and s-domain design, bode analysis, state-space methods, and discrete-time implementation considerations.

• Hands-on experience with discrete SiC and/or GaN FET-based power stages in the multi-kW range.

• Familiarity with military or aerospace environments and standards such as MIL-STD-461, 464, 810, or DO-160.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• MS/PhD with a focus in power electronics controls or control systems.

• Experience writing embedded firmware (C/C++) for microcontrollers or DSPs used in power converter control (e.g., TI C2000, STM32).

• Familiarity with auto-code generation from Simulink (Embedded Coder) or similar model-based design toolchains.

• Experience with real-time HIL platforms (e.g., Typhoon HIL, dSPACE, OPAL-RT).

• Knowledge of advanced modulation techniques (SVM, DPWM) and their impact on switching losses in wide-bandgap devices.

• Design-for-Reliability practices including DFMEA.

• Experience with EMI mitigation strategies at the controls and layout level.

We’re looking for someone who shares that mindset.

Improve our inbound sales team’s conversion rate.

title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, Domain Enablement (R5536)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI ’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
Job Description:

The Senior Data & Analytics Engineer is a hybrid builder role focused on enabling business domains onto the Databricks platform by developing governed Silver and Gold assets, reusable semantic patterns, and domain-ready analytical models. This role sits between pure data engineering and pure analytics engineering: it requires enough technical depth to work comfortably with transformations and lakehouse patterns, and enough business fluency to build trustworthy models that business stakeholders can use and extend.

Initial focus for this role is expected to be G&A and GTM-oriented domains such as Accounting, Program Finance, RevOps, Marketing, HR, and adjacent business functions, while remaining flexible enough to support more complex future domains such as Product or Engineering as the team matures. This role is not a dashboard factory; it is responsible for durable, governed datasets and semantic assets that accelerate domain self-service while maintaining enterprise consistency.

What you'll do:

• Build and maintain Silver and Gold data models, domain marts, curated datasets, and semantic assets for priority domains onboarding to Databricks.

• Partner directly with business stakeholders to translate domain requirements and KPI definitions into governed, testable, and reusable transformation logic.

• Apply enterprise modeling standards, naming conventions, semantic definitions, and promotion rules, contributing practical improvements back into those standards.

• Create reusable domain patterns and analytical building blocks that allow teams such as FP&A, RevOps, and Marketing to operate more self-service over time.

• Support the design of semantic views and curated layers that can be consumed by BI tools, Databricks SQL, and Genie or related AI/BI experiences.

title: Post-doctorant(e) : Problèmes publics des centres de données - Chaire SHS TerrAINs - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.
La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs.

Contexte scientifique :

La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029).
Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude.

Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux - de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement - et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux - de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement.

Au sein de la Chaire, le ou la post-doctorant(e) étudiera la manière dont les centres de données, objets clés de l’infrastructure numérique, se développent et organisent différents problèmes publics relatifs aux « territoires » à différentes échelles territoriales. Comment en retour, la définition et la hiérarchisation de ces problèmes peuvent permettent des arbitrages concertés pour planifier leur déploiement ?

Les modalités de participation à la construction de ces problèmes publics, autant que la fabrique des données nécessaires pour nourrir les positions des acteurs, sont autant un enjeu de démocratie technique qu’une manière de retrouver prise sur l’aménagement des milieux de vie.
En articulant sociologie des sciences et des techniques et études urbaines avec une méthodologie innovante de recherche-action , TerrAINs contribue à rendre visibles et discutables les infrastructures numériques, tout en expérimentant des outils de représentation des problèmes et de participation, adaptées aux enjeux infrastructurels contemporains.

La Chaire est organisée selon trois axes principaux :

• Analyse des discours sur les centres de données, et notamment les discours médiatiques régionaux, nationaux et étrangers ;

• Description des modalités du « faire infrastructure » : pratiques situées, relations aux milieux, frictions. Cet axe investira trois sites franciliens concernés par des projets de centres hyperscale.

• la chaire est conçue comme un laboratoire de recherche-action qui expérimente de nouvelles modalités de représentation et de participation autour des infrastructures numériques.

Vos missions principales seront de :

• Assurer des missions de recherche dans le cadre de la Chaire Terrains

• Participer à l’animation de la chaire et contribuer aux projets menés par les autres membres de l’équipe

• Participer à des actions de valorisation des travaux menés au sein de la chaire

• Assurer des missions d’encadrement (stagiaires, workshops étudiant)

Consulter la description des missions complètes dans la fiche de poste détaillé

About SiGMA
SiGMA is a global events and media company bringing together businesses and professionals across the iGaming, technology, and emerging industries. Our events connect leading brands, suppliers, operators, and industry professionals across multiple international markets.
As we continue to expand our presence in Italy, we are looking for aF&B Partnerships Manager to help us build a strong network of Italian food and beverage brands, distributors, and suppliers and turn these relationships into commercial opportunities for our events.

We are looking for a highly connected, proactive, and commercially minded professional who knows the Italian food and beverage market and can open doors to relevant brands, distributors, and suppliers.
The main purpose of the role is to identify, approach, and develop relationships with Italian F&B suppliers and brands, with a particular focus on Rome and the surrounding market, and bring new suppliers and activations to SiGMA events.

• Identify and build a pipeline of relevant Italian food and beverage brands, distributors, suppliers, and potential partners.

• Use existing industry connections to introduce SiGMA to key decision-makers and new business opportunities.

• Develop and maintain long-term relationships with Italian suppliers and brands.

• Identify opportunities for suppliers to participate in SiGMA events through activations, partnerships, product placements, catering, sponsorships, and other commercial opportunities.

• Take ownership of supplier acquisition and follow the process from initial introduction through to confirmed activation or partnership.

• Build a strong understanding of the Italian F&B supplier landscape, particularly in Rome and the surrounding region.

• Attend relevant trade shows, industry events, and networking opportunities as a representative of SiGMA.

• Work closely with the Events, Logistics, Commercial, and Partnerships teams to turn supplier relationships into successful event activations.

• Negotiate and coordinate commercial arrangements with suppliers where required.

• Maintain an up-to-date database and pipeline of potential and active suppliers.

• Continuously identifynew brands and market opportunities that could add value to SiGMA events.

• Provide regular updates on supplier pipeline, opportunities, and market developments.
Requirements

• Native or fluent Italian and strong English communication skills.

• Existing network within the Italian food & beverage, hospitality, distribution, retail, or related industries.

• Strong knowledge of food and beverage brands, distributors, and suppliers in Italy.

• Proven experience in business development, partnerships, sales, supplier management, account management, events, or a similar commercial role.

• Strong networking and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to independently identify opportunities and turn contacts into business relationships.

• Commercially driven, proactive, and comfortable with targets and business development.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

• Willingness to travel and attend relevant industry and trade events.

• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with international teams.
Nice to Have

• Experience working with food distributors, hospitality groups, FMCG companies, or F&B brands.

• Experience in event partnerships, sponsorships, activations, or supplier acquisition.

• Strong understanding of the Italian food and hospitality market.

• Experience working in an international or fast-growing company.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Clearance Required
description:
Overview
The Senior Data Scientist will support the Defense Health Agency (DHA) Revenue Cycle Operating System (RevOS) initiative by designing and implementing advanced analytics, statistical models, predictive capabilities, and decision-support visualizations within a Databricks-based environment.
The role will focus on transforming complex healthcare, financial, coding, claims, payment, and operational data into actionable intelligence that enables DHA to identify revenue leakage, coding and charge-capture errors, denied or stalled claims, underpayments, aged receivables, and opportunities to recover revenue.
The Senior Data Scientist will work closely with Data Engineers, Revenue Cycle SMEs, DHA stakeholders, and product leadership to develop analytics aligned to the end-to-end revenue-cycle workflow:
Scheduling → Eligibility → Registration → Authorization → Patient Care → Documentation → Coding → Charge Capture → Claims → Adjudication → Remittance → Denials → Collections / Recovery
The objective is not simply to produce reports. The role will help create analytical products and Databricks-based dashboards that identify where revenue-cycle processes are failing, quantify financial impact, prioritize corrective action, and measure recovery.
LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.
Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.
Responsibilities

• Design and develop advanced analytics within Databricks using Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, statistical methods, and machine-learning techniques.

• Develop Databricks visualizations, Databricks SQL dashboards, AI/BI dashboards, and related native visualization capabilities to provide operational and executive visibility into RevOS performance.

• Create interactive dashboards supporting DHA J-8, DHN, MTF, revenue-cycle, coding, financial, and executive users.

• Translate analytical models into intuitive visualizations showing financial exposure, recovery opportunity, trends, root causes, outliers, and recommended operational priorities.

• Develop command-level RevOS SITREP dashboards using Healthy / At Risk / Critical indicators across the Front, Middle, and Back Office revenue cycle.

• Develop drill-down analytics from enterprise and DHN levels through MTF, department, provider, encounter, claim, and claim-line levels.

• Design and develop analytical models that identify and quantify potential revenue leakage and recovery opportunities .

• Analyze encounter, documentation, coding, charge, claim, denial, adjudication, payment, and accounts-receivable data to identify patterns associated with lost or delayed revenue.

• Develop detection logic for:

• Missing or incomplete charges

• Uncoded and delayed encounters

• Coding inconsistencies and potential coding errors

• Claims-readiness defects

• Denied and rejected claims

• Underpayments and unexplained payment variances

• Unmatched or unposted remittances

• Aged claims and receivables

• Eligibility and authorization failures

• Develop recoverability and priority-scoring models based on financial value, probability of recovery, aging, filing/appeal deadlines, and operational severity.

• Develop payer-performance and denial analytics to identify recurring payer behaviors, denial patterns, reimbursement variances, and process failures.

• Build predictive models

- Review and approve employee travel and expense reports in Ramp, checking receipts, coding and compliance with company policy, resolving exceptions with employees, and helping improve AI-assisted review and automation.

title: Australia Content Specialist
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

We're looking for an ambitious, growth-obsessed Content Specialist who basically thinks in TikToks. Someone who gets fired up by great content, knows what's trending before it trends, and wants to take Bump to #1 on the App Store in Australia (and keep it there).

You'll be the person bringing internet culture from Australia into the heart of our Paris office, creating content, leading creators, testing wild ideas, breaking things (in a good way), and helping us build Bump into a must-have app.

If that sounds like your dream job, keep reading.

YOU ARE:

- Ambitious, driven, and wildly creative.

- A natural storyteller who knows exactly why one video flops and another takes off.

- Someone who spends more time on TikTok than you'd ever admit publicly.

- Comfortable giving creators feedback that actually makes their content better.

- Deeply tuned into Australian memes, humour, and online culture.

- Fluent in English and lived in Australia.

- Excited to work onsite in Paris, with a fast-moving team.

- Scrappy, energetic, experimental, you love trying 10 ideas to find the 1 that blows up, yet rigorous and detail oriented.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Grow Bump in Australia (yep, you'll actually own this).

- Lead all content + creator efforts for the Australian market.

- Make high-performing TikToks, Reels, and UGC-style ads that people actually want to watch.

- Build and manage a pipeline of Australian creators.

- Run influencer campaigns with top Australian creators and micro-influencers.

- Work closely with paid marketing to turn great content into great performance.

- Jump on trends before they hit the For You Page.

- Write briefs, give notes, and help external creators shine.

- Collaborate daily in our Paris office with growth, distribution, and product.

- Join brainstorms, test ideas fast, and help shape the creative direction of Bump.

- Support launches, events, and Australia-focused activations.

REQUIREMENTS:

- 1-5+ years making short-form content (brand, agency, influencer, or creator, we care more about your work than your title).

- Experience making content for ads (UGC especially).

- Experience managing creators or giving creative feedback.

- Deep knowledge of TikTok/IG trends and the Australian creator landscape.

- English language proficiency.

- Experience living in Australia.

- Must be willing to work in person in Paris.

- Work in Paris with an ambitious, high-energy team that moves fast.

- Own the entire Australian market for one of the world's fastest-growing consumer apps.

- Make content seen by millions and watch your work directly drive growth.

- Do the kind of creative work most companies would never let you try.

- Build a content engine from scratch and shape how Bump shows up in Australia.

- We test fast, learn fast, and celebrate wins properly.

title: HighLevel Automation and Integrations Specialist
description:
A women-owned and women-led marketing agency built on the HighLevel (GoHighLevel) platform is seeking a skilled HighLevel Automation and Integrations Specialist to join its operations team. The agency manages a growing portfolio of client sub-accounts across real estate, mortgage, home services, moving companies, and other industries.
This is a technical operations role that goes well beyond executing predefined tasks. The right candidate can take a business process or desired outcome, ask the right discovery questions, identify the triggers, conditions, data requirements, integrations, dependencies, and edge cases, and translate all of that into a clear technical specification and build plan. From there, they build it - in HighLevel and across connected platforms - and document it clearly enough that the delivery team can maintain it.
You will work directly with the Director of Operations and a Philippines-based delivery team. Clear documentation is not optional here; it is a core deliverable.
What This Role Requires Above All Else
The most important competency for this role is the ability to translate business logic into a buildable technical system. The right candidate does not need every workflow handed to them step by step. They start with the business goal, identify what is missing, and design the architecture that supports it.

• Asks the right discovery questions before beginning any build

• Maps business processes into triggers, conditions, branches, actions, waits, exit criteria, data requirements, and integrations

• Identifies missing information, dependencies, conflicting requirements, edge cases, and failure points before implementation begins

• Defines what data must exist, where it comes from, how it is stored, and how records are matched or deduplicated

• Creates a clear technical specification and build plan that another team member can understand, test, and maintain

• Recommends the simplest reliable solution rather than defaulting to the most complex tool

• Plans for testing, error handling, monitoring, and handoff, not only the expected path

Core Technical Skills
HighLevel / GoHighLevel / LeadConnector

• Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience at the agency level, not only inside a single business account

• Workflows, triggers, pipelines, opportunities, custom fields, custom values, and tags

• Snapshots, sub-account management, user roles, and SaaS versus standard sub-account configurations

• Email builder, templates, and Handlebars or custom value logic, including known limitations and workarounds

• Forms, surveys, funnels and websites, calendars, and domain connection

• Experience with HighLevel AI features (AI Studio, Conversation AI) is a strong plus

APIs and Integrations

• Reads API documentation and builds integrations from it independently

• REST APIs, authentication (API keys, OAuth), webhooks (inbound and outbound), JSON payloads, pagination, and rate limits

• HighLevel / LeadConnector API (v2)

• Designs integrations that prevent duplicate records, including storing external IDs in custom fields and upserting

• Advanced Zapier and Make (Integromat): multi-step scenarios, webhooks, filters, paths, and error handling

• Knows when no-code tools are sufficient and when a custom script or small service is the better choice

Scripting and Automation

• Working proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript (Node.js)

• Data transformation: CSV and JSON processing, deduplication, mapping, and enrichment

• Experience with Google Sheets / Drive APIs and the Asana API

• Strong habits around credential security, version control (Git), and documented code

AI Tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP)

• Understands MCP: can set up and configure MCP servers and connectors, and ideally build simple ones

• Uses AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) and AI agents for real operations work such as bulk updates, audits, reporting, and data processing

• Verifies AI output rather than accepting it without review

title: Software Engineer- Maps Rendering
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

Applied Intuition is looking for map rendering engineers with passion and expertise in owning and maintaining web rendering and editing tools geared towards HD maps for autonomous vehicles.

At Applied we treat maps not as a static dataset, but as a single integrated, self-healing data flywheel powering Physical AI. Fleets of vehicles collect ground truth from multimodal sensors which feed ingestion pipelines, dynamic change detection algorithms, machine learning models, and real-time onboard localization and map fusion -closing the loop between field data collection and instantaneous autonomy stack updates.

All of this map data needs to be visualized and edited performantly. In this full time role on the Maps team, you’ll help us build out map visualization tools that operate at every part of the process of developing an autonomy stack. You will operate across verticals - from long-haul L4 commercial trucks to L2++ personal cars, to heavy mining rigs, and tactical defense platforms - and context - real operations and simulations - to visualize standard and high definition map data, LiDAR point clouds, detailed 3D models and more.

Our map editor is used everyday by mapping specialists at Applied and across our commercial customers to triage and edit maps. We treat it as our map visualization & editing engine’s first and best customer, shipping features every single day to improve the experience. We also use our engine to power other mapping experiences across the company: you will help us build something battle-tested for a diversity of use cases. A successful candidate will be able to work across many contexts, including on-vehicle visualization, to push forward maps at Applied.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own and drive forward a 3D WebGPU map visualization and editing engine.

- Integrate the map visualization and editing engine into experiences across the company, including our primary map editor

- Build multiplayer web-based editing experiences

- Hold the line and drive best practices on performance: we expect to run at 120fps on any modern machine for country-scale HD maps

- Integrate mapping tools from across the company and industry, including map querying, map validation and programmatic map transforms

- Help define data storage formats that support map visualization

- Work with other engineers to develop data schemas and APIs that are visualization-friendly

- Work across all 3D experiences at the company to ensure an integrated fit and feel

- Advise customers on the effective use of map visualization to increase product quality and drive forward autonomy programs

title: AI Data Analyst - Merchant Acquisition
description:
About Us

We are an established Independent Sales Organization with seven years of experience in the credit-card-processing and merchant-services industry. We understand how merchants evaluate processors, why they consider switching, the objections they raise and the factors that ultimately drive conversion.

We are building a proprietary, AI-driven lead-intelligence platform to identify and prioritize merchants most likely to become customers. Our goal is to combine our industry knowledge, current sales-call recordings, operational information and external business data into a system that makes prospecting more scientific, targeted and measurable.

We are seeking an entrepreneurial data-science leader to design and lead this initiative from research and prototype development through prospective testing and commercialization.

The Opportunity

This is not a conventional data-science position in which a completed dataset and predefined model are handed to you. You will help determine what data matters, how it should be collected and labeled, and how qualitative sales intelligence can be transformed into quantitative predictions.

Because our historical labeled data is limited, the initial work will include analyzing current sales-call recordings, interviewing members of our sales organization and identifying the characteristics, circumstances and behaviors associated with merchants who are receptive to switching processors.

The successful candidate will build an initial lead-scoring methodology, test it against real-world sales results and continuously improve it as new outcome data is generated.

This is a founding-level opportunity with salary and equity participation in the resulting platform. The right candidate will have substantial autonomy and the opportunity to create a potentially valuable commercial product within an established operating business.

Responsibilities

• Develop the overall research, data and AI strategy for a proprietary merchant lead-intelligence platform.

• Analyze recorded sales conversations using transcription, natural-language processing, large language models and human-reviewed qualitative research.

• Create a structured framework for extracting relevant information from calls, including merchant characteristics, processing concerns, switching triggers, objections, urgency, decision-maker engagement and sales outcomes.

• Interview sales representatives and company leadership to capture domain knowledge that may not appear in existing structured data.

• Design reliable labeling and quality-control procedures for call transcripts and sales outcomes.

• Identify the signals most likely to predict meaningful sales progression, including statement submissions, follow-up meetings, proposals and signed merchant accounts.

• Develop an initial transparent, rules-based scoring model suitable for use while labeled data remains limited.

• Progressively develop statistical and machine-learning models as sufficient prospective data becomes available.

• Identify and evaluate external data sources that could reveal merchant size, growth, industry, number of locations, technology, ownership changes, hiring activity and other relevant characteristics.

• Connect internal conversation insights to externally observable business signals that can be used to identify new prospects.

• Design controlled sales experiments comparing AI-selected leads with leads selected through our existing process.

• Establish appropriate performance metrics, including conversion lift, precision among top-ranked leads, customer-acquisition cost and expected merchant profitability.

• Work with sales leadership to integrate lead recommendations into the company’s existing workflow.

• Build or manage the development of an initial working prototype and subsequent production platform.

Claims Adjuster - Liability | GL & BI | Jurisdiction: All States | Licensing: Home state required(Remote) Are you looking for an opportunity to join a global industry leader where you can bring your big ideas to help solve problems for some of the world’s best brands?

​
ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE? We are looking for driven individuals that embody our caring counts model and core values that include empathy, accountability, collaboration, growth, and inclusion.

PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE: To analyze complex or technically liability claims to determine benefits due; to work with high exposure claims involving litigation and rehabilitation; to ensure ongoing adjudication of claims within service expectations, industry best practices and specific client service requirements; and to identify subrogation of claims and negotiate settlements.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES MAY INCLUDE

• Analyzing and processing claims through well-developed action plans to an appropriate and timely resolution by investigating and gathering information to determine the exposure on the claim. 

• Negotiating settlement of claims within designated authority. 

• Communicating claim activity and processing with the claimant and the client. 

• Reporting claims to the excess carrier and responding to requests of directions in a professional and timely manner.
​
QUALIFICATIONS
Education & Licensing: High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university preferred. Professional certification as applicable to line of business preferred.
Experience: 4 years of claims management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
Licensing: Home state required
Jurisdiction Knowledge: All States

title: Quality Engineer – QA Control Account Manager
description:
***Active DoD Security Clearance Preferred***
***US Citizenship Required***
***NO VISA SUPPORT or C2C***
Primary Function
Long Wave Inc. is seeking a Quality Engineer - QA Control Account Manager (CAM) to support program quality assurance, Control Account Management, Quality Management System (QMS) execution, and departmental budget and resource planning within an aerospace and defense environment.
The position serves as the designated QA CAM for assigned programs, managing cost account performance, forecasts, budgets, and associated EVMS responsibilities. In addition, the position supports program QA execution, internal auditing, corrective action activities, and QMS implementation and sustainment.
This is a hands-on individual contributor position requiring coordination with Program Management, Finance, Quality leadership, and other functional organizations.
Essential Responsibilities
QA Control Account Management

• Serve as QA CAM for assigned control accounts, managing scope, schedule, budget, and resource requirements.

• Develop and maintain ETCs, EACs, and forecasts; support development and maintenance of control account baselines.

• Monitor cost and schedule performance, prepare variance analyses, and identify execution risks and corrective actions.

• Maintain CAM records and objective evidence supporting internal, customer, government, and DCMA EVMS reviews.

• Support BCRs, IBRs, program reviews, and recurring EVMS reporting activities.

• Coordinate with Program Management, Finance, and functional leads to ensure QA work is properly planned, budgeted, and executed.

QA Budget & Resource Planning

• Support QA annual operating plans (AOPs), budgets, staffing, and resource forecasts across assigned programs and departmental activities.

• Monitor planned versus actual QA labor and budget performance, identifying resource gaps and providing recurring status to QA leadership.

• Develop and support QA BOEs, proposal estimates, resource planning, and program changes involving QA labor and resource requirements.

Additional QA & QMS Support

• Support program QA execution activities, including quality planning, requirements compliance, documentation reviews, and program quality reporting.

• Conduct or support AS9100/ISO 9001 internal audits, including audit planning, objective evidence review, reporting, and follow-up.

• Support nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness verification.

• Assist with customer and certification audits, QMS implementation, sustainment, and continual improvement activities as assigned.

Work Conditions

• Remote or on-site work arrangement based on business needs and position requirements.

• Remote employees must be able to perform assigned duties and access authorized company systems in accordance with company and contractual requirements.

• Occasional travel may be required in support of program, customer, or QMS activities.

Minimum Qualifications

• U.S. Citizenship required.

• Bachelor's degree and a minimum of four (4) years of relevant experience; or a graduate degree and a minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience.

• Proficient knowledge of program controls, cost account management, quality assurance, or related disciplines, with practical knowledge of project management.

• Experience performing or directly supporting Control Account Management, program controls, budgeting, forecasting, or comparable cost and schedule management activities.

• Working knowledge of EVM/EVMS principles, including cost and schedule performance, variance analysis, and resource planning.

• Strong analytical and organizational skills with proficiency in Excel and related reporting or data analysis tools.
